rationale: Weiru brings product marketing expertise from ByteDance's creator platforms (TikTok, CapCut) while Saurabh is building AI-adjacent developer tools and has hands-on experience shipping consumer-AI products. Both share the consumer-AI domain and could explore how creator economy insights translate to AI tooling—whether for matchmaking platforms, agentic tools, or the next generation of creator-focused AI applications.
intro_message: Weiru @Creative Community, meet Saurabh Khire — he's an AI engineer at HiJenny AI building developer tools and creator-focused platforms, and your product marketing background at ByteDance could offer valuable perspective on positioning AI tools for creators.
